title: Frequency-Aware Model Parameter Explorer: A new attribution method for improving explainability
abstract: arXiv:2510.03245v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: State-of-the-art attribution methods such as AttEXplore rely on adversarial sample generation that applies an all-pass filter across the frequency spectrum: they perturb all frequencies of the input image alike, from the low frequencies that carry coarse shape to the high frequencies that carry edges and textures. However, models rely on low and high frequencies to different degrees, and such an all-pass perturbation cannot adapt to the model being explained, which limits the faithfulness of the resulting attribution maps. We propose FAMPE (Frequency-Aware Model Parameter Explorer), an attribution method that overcomes this limitation by perturbing the low- and high-frequency bands of the input independently, so that the perturbation can be shifted toward the band that matters for the model. translated_title: 频率感知模型参数探索器：一种提升可解释性的新归因方法
translated_abstract: 最先进的归因方法（如 AttEXplore）依赖于对抗样本生成，其采用覆盖整个频谱的全通滤波器：它们对输入图像的所有频率进行同等程度的扰动，从承载粗略形状的低频到承载边缘和纹理的高频。然而，模型对低频和高频的依赖程度各不相同，这种全通扰动无法适应被解释的模型，从而限制了所得归因图的可信度。我们提出了 FAMPE（频率感知模型参数探索器），这是一种通过独立扰动输入图像的低频和高频频带来克服这一局限的归因方法，使扰动能够偏向对模型而言重要的频带。两个频带之间的边界根据图像的频谱能量自动设定。在 ImageNet 数据集上，使用五个卷积神经网络（摘要在此处截断）……
tldr: 提出频率感知归因方法 FAMPE，通过独立扰动输入图像的低频和高频频带、并根据频谱能量自动确定频带边界，使扰动适应被解释模型所依赖的频率，从而提升归因图的可信度。
en_tdlr: FAMPE is a frequency-aware attribution method that independently perturbs the low- and high-frequency bands of input images, with band boundaries automatically determined from spectral energy, so that perturbations adapt to the frequencies the model relies on, thereby improving the faithfulness of attribution maps.
